title: Return an ordered textual summary per group
goal: Combine each group into predictable text in SQLite, ordering values inside server-side aggregation.

selectionNotes: Combine each group into predictable text in SQLite, ordering values inside server-side aggregation.

SQLite 3.44+ is required for aggregate ORDER BY. The real current sample uses the provider native bundle and SQLite 3.53.4; the older sample uses 3.53.3. EF11 requires net11.0. This replaces client evaluation/workaround for the demonstrated query shape. Nulls, collation and separators require application-specific rules; this fixture has non-null text and integer order keys. No allocation or throughput improvement is measured.

sources.title: EF11 ordering in SQLite string aggregation

evidence.scope: Actual in-memory native SQLite, deterministic two-group summaries including tied positions; EF11 generated SQL contains ordered group_concat. EF10 materializes rows before local grouping. Windows x64 only; no GA claim.
